name: Get Stuck In
text: Use during the Fight phase, before you pick the next unit to fight. For the rest of the phase, one ORKS unit from your army that has not yet been selected to fight this phase treats its Pile-in and Consolidation moves as up to 6" rather than 3".

name: Brutal but Kunnin'
text: Use at the start of your Charge phase. For the rest of the phase, one ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army may declare a charge even though it Fell Back earlier this turn.

name: Krump da Gitz!
text: Use once an enemy unit finishes shooting during the opponent's Shooting phase, if it targeted one of your ORKS units. That unit immediately makes a Normal move of up to D6", moving as near as it can to the enemy unit that shot at it.
